title: LEGO 42197 — halol hisob: yolg'iz olmang
caption: 🧱 LEGO Technic 42197 — $5.99, lekin… LEGO Technic ekskavator-yuklagich (42197, 104 detal): $9.99 → $5.99 (−40%). 💰 Chetdan olib kelish • Tovar — $5.99 • AQShdan yetkazish — ~$10 • Bojxona — 0 so'm (tovar 200 $ normadan arzon) • Jami ≈ 184 000 so'm 🇺🇿 Toshkentda: Texnomart — 210 000 so'm (xuddi shu to'plam) ➖ Farq atigi ≈ 26 000 so'm (12%) 💡 Yolg'iz buyurtma qilmang. Yetkazish (kamida 1 kg tarifi) tovarning o'zidan qimmat. Boshqa posilka bilan birga oling — shunda u deyarli tovar narxida keladi. 🔗 Amazonda ko'rish 📲 Bojni ilovada hisoblang Kurs: 1 $ = 11 897,90 so'm (10.10.2026, Markaziy bank). Narxlar o'zgarishi mumkin. ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #narx
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 e-commerce discount card for a Telegram channel. Flat, modern, premium. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape covering the top ~20% of the frame.

Use the attached product photo as the hero image. Keep the product exactly as it is — do not redraw, restyle or alter it; only cut it out cleanly from its background.

LAYOUT, top to bottom:
1) Top row of pills: left — a solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold uppercase text "AMAZON" (plain text, no logo); next to it — a white pill with a thin light-grey border and grey text "AQSh"; right edge — a solid crimson (#E11D48) rounded pill with white bold uppercase text "CHEGIRMA".
2) A large white rounded rectangle (24px radius) with a soft realistic drop shadow, about 40% of the frame height. The product photo centered inside it, with a soft studio shadow beneath.
3) Overlapping the top-right corner of that rectangle: a solid crimson (#E11D48) circle with a thin white outer ring. Inside, in white: large bold "-40%" and beneath it small uppercase "CHEGIRMA".
4) Headline in bold near-black (#11111B), large: "LEGO Technic 42197"
5) Price row: very large bold indigo (#4F46E5) "$5.99" and immediately to its right, smaller grey "$9.99" with a horizontal strikethrough line.
6) A light grey (#F6F6FB) rounded panel with a thin border containing:
   - small bold indigo uppercase label: "NARX SOLISHTIRUVI"
   - row: left grey text "O'zbekistonda (Texnomart)", right bold near-black "210 000 so'm"
   - row: left grey text "Chetdan (tovar+yetkazish+boj)", right bold indigo "184 000 so'm"
   - a thin divider line
   - row: left bold amber (#D97706) uppercase "FARQ", right large bold amber (#D97706) "26 000 so'm"
7) Bottom, above a thin divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo", right smaller grey "Chegirmalar - Kuryerlik - Bojxona"

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes:
TASDIQLASHDAN OLDIN: AQSh narxi va O'zbekistondagi narxni saytlarda tekshiring (Claude muhitidan do'konlar ochilmadi, narxlar qidiruv natijalaridan). Slickdeals/9to5Toys: $5.99 (odatda $9.99) — chegirma 07.10 atrofida. ASIN topilmadi — havola Amazon qidiruvi. Texnomart narxi katalogdan (tovar sahifasi topilmadi).
Hisob: tovar $5.99 + yetkazish ~$9.50 + boj $0 = $15.49 × 11897.9 = 184 000 so'm. Tejash: 210 000 − 184 000 = 26 000 so'm (12%).
